verified_components: Node22 working cloud collection of unofficial sports observations across eight category labels
Uncalibrated pre-event model abstains on insufficient evidence; preserves SHA-256 evidence receipts
Atomic append-only GitHub tree commit with no force updates and limited safe retries
Source replay beyond ordinary historical lookback for postgame verification
Source participant ID and scheduled-time checks before preliminary grading
No false zero-zero outcomes from null or blank score fields
Source coverage gate rejects fewer than 60 percent of feed requests
Provider score contradictions quarantined from forward evidence
Per-run report distinguishes started awaiting results, overdue cases and provisional grade generated
Phone-readable immutable GitHub scorecard with pending event links and age
Unit-tested second-writer race suppression with explicit conflict receipt and canonical first-forecast retention
All automated wagering and training updates disabled
caveats: Mocked postgame lifecycle passed but no live postgame preliminary grade has yet been observed
GitHub scheduler configured twice per day but a clock-triggered production run has not yet been verified
Third-party ESPN site feed is undocumented: successful HTTP requests do not establish a data license
No provider-authenticated market prices, player props, period props, scorer props, bookmaker settlement or calibrated forecasting
The Jhadina phone route /sports-lab passed web build but production deployment is blocked by Vercel free daily deployment quota

ownership.routine_maintenance: GitHub Actions; no phone required for configured scheduled runs
ownership.review_after_event: Independent next run must detect a genuine completed predicted fixture, append a provisional grade and update Brier metrics
ownership.watch_out_for: GitHub Actions time drift and source availability; schedule cannot guarantee wall-clock timing
